reviews.review:
You can clearly see that this is a low budget game. The story and characters are nothing but a big cliche. The voice acting is bad. There are sections in the game which have infuriatingly bad controls (I'm looking at you, laser room). And it's very short.

So, why do I still give it a thumbs up?

Because most imprtantly I had a lot of fun playing this game. It also has something that most AAA games don't have: it was made with passion. What's also surprisingly good for a low budget game are the character models and animations. It felt like they put a lot of time into creating them. I generally liked the character design in this game. As cliched as they were, the characters are very likeable, especially the main character who I personally adored. The level design was a bit questionable at points but offered a lot of variety. Ironically I wish they stretched out some parts of the game. The music also wasn't bad at all. So despite all the cons, this is a pretty solid and enjoyable game. It's not the best game ever made or a GOTY candidate, but most definitely exceeded expectations.

I'll be waiting for Episode 2!
